title: Swap header logo to uploaded Genz App image while preserving asset path

requirements.summary: Replace the existing logo asset with the uploaded image while keeping the same static asset path and ensuring crisp, uncropped header rendering at 40x40 with rounded corners.
acceptanceCriteria: The file `frontend/public/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` is replaced/updated to visually match the uploaded logo.
The header continues to load the logo from `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` (no broken images).
The logo renders crisply in the header at 40x40, with no unintended cropping of the central mark/text.

file_operations.description: Replace/update the static logo file at this exact path using the uploaded asset `Gemini_Generated_Image_f7iz8qf7iz8qf7iz.png`, ensuring the resulting file is a 512x512 PNG and optimized to render clearly at 40x40.

Adjust the header logo rendering to avoid unintended cropping at 40x40 (e.g., prefer contain-like behavior over cover while preserving rounded corners), and keep the src path exactly `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
